name: PR with two adversarial reviews
description: Creates a pull request, performs an adversarial review, remediates it, then requires a second review from a fresh agent identity before finalizing.
when_to_use: Apply whenever a work item is expected to create or materially update a pull request and the adversarial-review skill is available in the harness.

goal.description: The concrete change the pull request must accomplish.

test_command.description: The project-approved command that demonstrates the change is passing.

stages.title: Implement and open PR: {goal}
stages.description: Implement the bounded change: {goal}. Run the project checks, push the branch, and open a pull request against {base_branch}. Record the PR URL and commit SHA. Do not perform the adversarial review in this stage.
acceptance: The requested change is implemented without unrelated modifications
The command `{test_command}` passes before the pull request is opened
A pull request against `{base_branch}` exists and its URL and head commit SHA are recorded
The working tree and remote branch state are accounted for

stages.title: First adversarial review: {goal}
stages.description: Start from the pull request produced by the dependency. Invoke the harness skill named `adversarial-review`. Review the complete PR diff and relevant tests. Do not modify the PR. Write a durable review artifact containing prioritized findings, exact file/line evidence, and the reviewed commit SHA.
acceptance: The `adversarial-review` skill was invoked against the PR
The reviewed PR URL and exact head commit SHA are recorded
Every finding has severity, evidence, and a concrete remediation or explicit no-change rationale
The review is registered as a durable artifact

stages.title: Remediate first review and restore green checks: {goal}
stages.description: Read the first adversarial-review artifact. Fix every supported finding, explicitly disposition unsupported findings, update the existing PR, and rerun `{test_command}`. Record the new head commit SHA and check results.
acceptance: Every first-review finding is fixed or has an evidence-based disposition
The existing PR contains the remediation commits
The command `{test_command}` passes after remediation
The updated PR head commit SHA is recorded

stages.title: Fresh-session adversarial review: {goal}
stages.description: In a fresh agent invocation, independently inspect the updated pull request. Invoke the harness skill named `adversarial-review`; do not rely on the first review's conclusions. Do not modify the PR. Write a new durable review artifact with the reviewed commit SHA and any remaining or newly introduced findings.
acceptance: A fresh agent identity invoked the `adversarial-review` skill
The second review independently covers the complete updated PR diff
The reviewed head commit SHA is recorded
The second review is registered as a separate durable artifact

stages.title: Resolve final review and leave PR passing: {goal}
stages.description: Read the second adversarial-review artifact. Resolve every supported finding, update the same pull request if needed, rerun `{test_command}`, and confirm required PR checks are green. Record final commit and check evidence. Do not merge unless the mission explicitly authorizes merging.
acceptance: Every second-review finding is fixed or has an evidence-based disposition
The command `{test_command}` passes on the final PR head
Required remote PR checks are green or a durable blocker identifies the external check
The final PR URL and head commit SHA are recorded
The pull request was not merged without explicit authorization
